$reason: The trigger binds the two names as attributes spelled in camel case, `[attr.ariaLabel]` and `[attr.ariaLabelledby]`. An attribute binding goes through `setAttribute`, which makes them `arialabel` and `arialabelledby` — no ARIA at all: axe reports `button-name` (critical) in three engines and Firefox 157 computes an empty label. Only a PROPERTY binding, `[ariaLabel]`, reaches `aria-label` through its reflection; mapping every spelling to the ARIA name passes this as a carrier.
